## THANK YOU! SOEs made possible by (at least) 88 contributors from 20+ institutions {.small-text-slide}

```{r, results = "asis"}
contr <- c(create_contributors(contrib.file = here::here('utils', 'contributors_list.csv'), mode = "slide"), "NEFSC staff")

total <- length(contr)
len <- ceiling(total/4)
seqs <- seq(1, total, by = len)
```

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="25%"}

```{r, results = "asis"}
contr[seqs[1]:seqs[2]] |> 
  cat(sep = "<br>")
```

:::

::: {.column width="25%"}

```{r, results = "asis"}
contr[(seqs[2]+1):seqs[3]] |> 
  cat(sep = "<br>")
```

:::

::: {.column width="25%"}

```{r, results = "asis"}
contr[(seqs[3]+1):seqs[4]] |> 
  cat(sep = "<br>")
```

:::

::: {.column width="25%"}

```{r, results = "asis"}
contr[(seqs[4]+1):total] |> 
  cat(sep = "<br>")
```
